def FindSingleNumber (nums : List Int) (h_precond : FindSingleNumber_precond (nums)) : Int :=
  match nums with
  | [] => 0 -- This case is unreachable due to precondition
  | x :: xs =>
    let rec aux (acc : Int) (lst : List Int) : Int :=
      match lst with
      | [] => acc
      | y :: ys =>
        if y = acc then aux acc ys else aux y ys
    aux x xs
